reason: Complete native rich-tree captures show that physical Ctrl+A/Backspace can leave a presentation LF at caret zero. The exact-empty actor then blocks before the operation being tested. Real Enter produces different caret or topology in the retained captures.
decision: Introduce a pure, bounded empty-after-physical-clear predicate only in the native actor's clear prerequisite. Freeze the exact accessible endpoint before Ctrl+A/Backspace; verify the owned seat, application, focus and requested layout before and after observation. Leave all measured target checks unchanged.

consequences.allowed_shapes: An empty entry at caret zero with no children; or a single LF at caret zero with no children; or a single LF at caret zero with exactly one static leaf containing that LF, no selection and caret minus one. The root must have the observed editable div/textbox role, actual focused/editable/showing/visible states, no defunct state, no selection, stable raw readback and a complete bounded tree without read errors or hidden descendants.
consequences.scope: These shapes qualify only the immediately preceding physical clear of the frozen, still-focused endpoint. They are not general empty-text equivalence and cannot prove that arbitrary LF input is empty. Endpoint equality may not be obtained by assigning expected identity from the tree being checked.
consequences.rejections: Reject changed endpoints, missing or synthetic focus evidence, layout mismatch, unstable or incomplete trees, unexpected children, real-Enter topologies, nonempty descendants, suffix text and any U+FFFC representation. Do not flatten Hypertext or strip LF/NBSP generally.
consequences.authority: Test setup only. No runtime mutation, SafetyGate, verifier, reducer, IME delivery route, owner or re-admission authority changes. No extra RPC or wait is added to measured Double Shift operations.
consequences.receipts: Keep old clear failures and all original identities. New source and native attempts get separate hashes and receipts; passing presentation controls does not regrade a behavioral case.
consequences.rollback: Remove this predicate and its clear-only call site together; preserve captured native trees and earlier results. No installation or data migration.

verification: Use the actual captured Firefox and Chrome trees as positive controls, with real Enter, nonempty descendants, wrong identity, focus, selection, cursor, layout and incomplete-tree negatives. Run source controls on the actual target APIs before focused native prerequisites and unchanged behavioral scenarios. A full retained matrix is still required to change complete matrix counts.

evidence.observations: 42 complete/stable bounded trees, CAPTURED/UNQUALIFIED; no behavioral PASS or Double Shift latency claim.

focused_native.source_controls: 22 PASS per browser, zero skips; actual-host zero-key AT-SPI API PASS. Original actor and physical operations retained.
focused_native.behavior: Firefox 5 PASS / 1 FAIL and Chrome 0 PASS / 6 FAIL in the original roundtrip and short cells for fields 7, 8, 10. This subset does not regrade the complete matrices.
focused_native.clear_only: Firefox 5 of 6 physical clears qualified; first field-10 clear rejected despite empty text because the required root attributes were absent. Chrome 6 of 6 clears qualified, followed by actual first-Double-Shift failures.
focused_native.closure: Independent closure at 2026-10-18T21:24:47.025321Z (Firefox) and 2026-10-18T21:27:27.819007Z (Chrome): empty cgroups, original pinned processes gone, no held keys, VT1, owned seat stopped and temporary policy absent.
focused_native.not_tested: Full retained matrices with this predicate; unspecified rich-tree shapes. No predicate promotion or general empty-text equivalence follows.
